apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: No more screen flash on the watch.

Watch: a session started on the phone now shows on the watch even if the watch app was opened later or woke from a wrist-down. The phone keeps the running session and the Quick one menu side by side, so one no longer overwrites the other.
Phone cue sounds (the plucks, breaths and 3-2-1) are about three times louder at every volume setting. The voice is unchanged.
